transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, yes, thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I guess I'm here because I've been having a little trouble with my eating habits lately? I hope this is the right place to talk about this. 

It's just... well, usually after everyone goes to bed, I’ll tell myself I’m just going to have a small bite of some leftovers. Just to unwind from the day, you know? But then... I don't really know how it happens, but I’ll realize I’ve eaten, like, half a tray of catered pasta I brought home from work, and maybe the dessert from a client dinner, and then just... whatever snacks were in the pantry. All in one sitting. 

It's so embarrassing to admit out loud, and I know it probably sounds terrible... I just, I really want to get a handle on it, and I'm hoping I'm not making too big a deal out of it. Is that something you might be able to help me with?
When you find yourself eating large amounts of food after everyone goes to bed, do you feel like you're not in control of how much you're eating?

Well... um, yes, I suppose so. I hope that doesn't sound too strange. It's just... once I start, especially if it's been a really tense night with my husband, it's almost like the decision-making part of my brain just... goes offline? 

I don't want to make it sound like I'm completely out of my mind or anything, but I'll find myself just reaching for more and more. And the whole time, I'm actually thinking to myself, 'Patricia, stop, this is enough.' But I just keep going. Does that make sense? I really try to stop, I promise, it just... it gets a little hard to manage in the moment. Is that a normal thing to experience?
During these episodes when you're eating large amounts, do you find yourself eating much more quickly than you normally would?

Um... yes, I think so. I mean, I hope it's okay to admit this, but... I do tend to eat pretty quickly when it happens. 

Usually, I'm just standing right there at the kitchen island, or maybe I'm trying to catch up on some work emails on my phone while I eat. And... well, I eat so fast that I barely even taste the food, if I'm being completely honest. Sometimes I'll just look down and the containers are already empty, and I haven't even fully registered what I was eating. 

I know I shouldn't rush like that, and I really do try to be mindful, but it just kind of happens before I realize it. Is that... is that something you hear a lot from people? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
During these times when you're eating large amounts of food, do you find yourself eating until you feel uncomfortably full?

Um... yeah. Yes, I do. I mean, I really wish I didn't, and I hope you don't think less of me for saying this, but... yes. 

It's just... I'll keep eating, and by the end of it, I'm usually so full that my waistband actually hurts. Sometimes I even have to just sit straight up on the couch for a bit before I can go back to bed, because if I try to lie down right away, I'll feel physically sick. 

I know it's not good for me, and I feel so silly letting it get to that point. I really try to stop before I feel that way, I do. But it just sneaks up on me. I hope that's the kind of detail you were looking for? I just want to be as helpful as I can.
